scope: Independent read-only review of renderChangedSourceLine and 26 regression cases. No product changes, test execution, or native execution by this reviewer. Existing live parse-cache/read-only Tab changes were not reimplemented.

findings.assessment: Explicit virtual fallback; exactly one transaction/change, unchanged line count, old start/end and new insertion endpoint confined to one line; CR/LF in insertion or removed bytes rejected. Existing live branch remains separate.
All direct row count, class and line/from/to metadata are validated before any replacement or suffix update; failure returns to full rendering without a partial patch.

Changed row uses existing plain text renderer. Every later from/to is read from new state.doc.line, preserving UTF-16 offsets and CRLF display/source distinction; no visible-character delta assumption. Empty-line placeholder remains display-only.

Outer scrollTop/scrollLeft and changed-row scrollLeft explicitly restored; normal renderSelectionAndCursor refreshes selection/search overlays and input proxy. Existing updateState cursor reveal remains in control when selection changes.

Tests assert unrelated node identity, independent text/offset oracle, Unicode grow/shrink/replacement at start/middle/end, CRLF, empty line/EOF, reversed selection, history, retained-row click mapping, scroll properties, newline/CR/multiple/untracked fallback, missing-row repair, bounded virtual fallback.

nonBlockingLimitations.detail: Preflight covers row metadata/identity shape, not equality of old textContent or prohibition of nested child elements. Do not claim general arbitrary DOM corruption repair; source DOM is internally owned.
jsdom scroll property preservation does not establish browser wrapping, scrollbar clamping or actual native scroll behavior. Candidate03 measurement remains necessary.

The new 26 cases contain no dedicated search-highlight assertion; helper preserves the existing renderSelectionAndCursor path, which rerenders search highlights. No new history mapping or controlled renderer path was added.
Suffix metadata/preflight remain linear in ordinary row count. Reduced DOM reconstruction does not establish the cause of the original slow sample or a native tail-latency budget pass.

ownerEvidenceReadOnly.redCases: 17 failed / 9 passed (owner report; first raw result retained)

remainingGate: Root-coordinated candidate03 actual native timing and behavior; no native acceptance claimed.
